v26_field_authority.description: V26 authority migration profile. V26.1 establishes exact field-header ownership; V26.2 moves live Agent business semantics onto authority-bearing JudgementGraph, ActionGraph and OperationGraph without changing the sealed system Agent topology; V26.3 extends deterministic INVOCATION authority upstream so product lifecycle and statistical volatility decide whether an observation may enter QueueAuthority/Agent1 at all; V26.4 extends that same product lifecycle downstream through immutable review-contract freezing and deterministic System Review; V26.5 upgrades the business graph to addressable Judgement/Action/Operation nodes and system-generated lineage edges; V26.6 uses those immutable node identities after review to compile a deterministic local revision scope. Structured breached metrics map to exact Action nodes, downstream Action/Operation dependencies are reopened, unrelated successful nodes remain preserved, and revisionHash becomes the Agent1 queue identity. Legacy or unmapped review criteria fail closed to full-graph compatibility rather than pretending to localize. Models may read revision.* but may never author nodeHash, edgeHash, revisionHash, SystemStage or call-graph authority. FACT and DERIVED remain system-owned; Agent1 owns judgement.*, Agent2 owns plan.*, Agent3 owns operation.* and dynamic operation_stage.*; java-control-plane owns revision.*. Existing INFORMATION, INVOCATION, TEMPORAL and MUTATION roots are reused; no new authority domain is created. V26.7 closeout fixes finite numeric values, exact evidence references, graph budgets/cycles, cache identity, durable lifecycle locking, compiled review conditions and complete revision coverage; adds read-only SOP evidence projection and task-scoped V25 audit reads. System Agent topology and authority roots stay fixed.
